description: Search EverythingMeetsAI's record of AI's impact on real-world sectors: source-linked headlines placed in one of 18 sectors, with outlet, country, development type and time, since 24 June 2026. Filter by sector, country, outlet, development type, headline keyword and date. Returns headline, publisher link, outlet, sector and times; never article text. An empty result means no headline matched, not that nothing happened.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (or EU). Set on ~62% of stories.

development_type.description: Development-type slugs (see list_types). Set on ~8% of stories; most types are never used.

from.description: ISO date or datetime; stories first reported on or after.

limit.description: Page size. Anonymous callers get at most 25, keyed 50.

offset.description: Page start, for the next page.

paywalled.description: Only paywalled (true) or only free-to-read (false) stories.

query.description: Headline keyword search (web-search syntax: quotes, OR, -exclude). Not semantic.

sector.description: Primary sector slugs to include. Sector slugs: see list_sectors (e.g. healthcare_life_sciences, law, retail, regulation_government, financial_services, manufacturing_robotics).

to.description: ISO date or datetime; stories first reported on or before.

name: search_stories
title: Search AI-in-sector stories
